about: An AI or creator video brief: video-teardown -> video-writing -> filing + number -> video-production -> video-edit -> the approval card -> the Queue. Paths from the code (survey 2026-10-25): working folder runs/video-teardown/_work/<slug>/, filed copies runs/video-teardown/<brand>/<slug>/ and runs/video-writing/<brand>/<slug>/.
resolve: the register row's run is the bare slug (lane video-teardown); production runs are those whose run.json brief_from contains /<slug>/; edit runs are those whose edit-map.json from_run is that production run; cards carry brief_id brief-NNNN + product

steps.name: filed + brief number
steps.why_no_fix: filing runs at the end of a teardown run (file_run.py); a creator brief is numbered with briefs.py open --type video-creator

steps.name: production (voice, stills, clips)
steps.why_no_fix: production starts on a person's go (two OKs: production, then the final ad)

steps.name: the approval card
steps.why_no_fix: the edit line's step 7 files the card (to_check.py)
